scope: four actual Llama 3.2 3B frontend kernels, layer-0 checkpoint weights, synthetic activations; no full-model generation
measurement: one timing sample per mode/case; each case in fresh worker, space then meta_schedule; no hardware inference latency
experiment: meta_schedule: TVM ReplayFunc uniform sampling with NPU ScheduleFn

setup_timing.description: Setup only, two TuneContexts in one process; no candidates compiled

limitations: same existing normalized search space and NPU rules; not EvolutionarySearch or learned cost model
16 extension attempts, at most 4 legal extension candidates, 250000 emitted probe words; limits stop after a complete candidate and word cap can overshoot
512-token ordered extension found no feasible candidate within its 16 attempts; ReplayFunc extension stopped after one legal candidate on word budget
no fusion boundary search or cross-kernel SRAM residency comparison
no full-layer or full-28-layer generation; real checkpoint weights and synthetic normalized activations
MetaSchedule cold-start time included per worker; setup-only warm context timing is not a warm full compile benchmark
